_what: The words of an action whose outcome is not yet known, one source for the app, the SDKs and the MCP. {placeholders} are filled by the client. Copied into each repo with a drift check; never edited in a copy.

pending_checking.text: Pending — checking. Your order was sent but the answer was lost. Checking the network for it.
pending_checking.next: Do not place it again. This takes up to 2 minutes.

applied.text: {order_words}. Found on the network at block {height}.

not_applied.text: Not placed. The network did not take it, and its time to apply has passed.

still_unknown.text: Still not known after 2 minutes. It was not sent again and may still apply.
still_unknown.next: Check your open orders before you place it again.

pending_checking.text: Pending — checking. Your cancel was sent but the answer was lost. Checking whether the order is gone.
pending_checking.next: Wait. This takes up to 2 minutes.

applied.text: Cancelled. The order is off the book.

still_unknown.text: Still not known after 2 minutes. The order is still on the book.
still_unknown.next: You can cancel it again: cancelling twice has no extra effect.

still_unknown_gone.text: Still not known after 2 minutes. The order is off the book: it was cancelled or filled.

still_unknown_unread.text: Still not known after 2 minutes. The network's reads did not answer.
still_unknown_unread.next: You can cancel it again: cancelling twice has no extra effect.

pending_checking.text: Pending — checking. Cancel all was sent but the answer was lost. Checking your open orders.
pending_checking.next: Wait. This takes up to 2 minutes.

still_unknown.text: Still not known after 2 minutes. {n} orders are still open.
still_unknown.next: Check your open orders; cancel what is still open.

still_unknown_unread.text: Still not known after 2 minutes. The network's reads did not answer.
still_unknown_unread.next: Check your open orders; cancel what is still open.

pending_checking.text: Pending — checking. The closes were sent but the answers were lost. Checking your positions.
pending_checking.next: Wait. This takes up to 2 minutes.

applied_other.next: Close them on the trading page.

still_unknown.text: Still not known after 2 minutes. {n} positions are still open.
still_unknown.next: Close what is still open on the trading page.

pending_checking.text: Pending — checking. The revoke was sent. Checking that the agent is revoked.
pending_checking.next: Wait. This takes up to 2 minutes.

applied.text: Agent revoked at block {height}. {m} orders cancelled.

still_unknown.text: Still not known after 2 minutes. The agent is still live.
still_unknown.next: You can revoke again: it has no extra effect.

still_unknown_unread.text: Still not known after 2 minutes. The network's reads did not answer.
still_unknown_unread.next: You can revoke again: it has no extra effect.

pending_checking.text: Pending — checking. The stop was sent. Checking that your trading key and agents are stopped.
pending_checking.next: Wait. This takes up to 2 minutes.

applied.text: Stopped on the network: no trading key, no live agent, no open order.

applied_other.text: Your trading key and every agent are stopped. {n} orders your wallet placed itself stay open.

not_applied.text: Not stopped. That signature has passed its time to apply.

still_unknown.next: You can stop again: it has no extra effect.
